topics.title: Uses of Building Materials JSS 1 (Basic 1) - Basic Technology
topics.content:
BASIC TECHNOLOGY
BASIC SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
THIRD TERM
WEEK 3
JUNIOR SECONDARY SCHOOL (JSS 1)
THEME: BUILDING
PREVIOUS LESSON - Types of Building | Common Building Materials JSS 1 (Basic 7) - Basic Technology
TOPIC - BUILDING AND BUILDING MATERIALS
LEARNING AREA
1. Introductory Activities
2. Common Building Materials
3. Uses of Common Building Materials
4. Revision and Weekly Assessment (Test)
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, most of the students should have attained the following objectives (cognitive, affective and psychomotor) and should be able to -
1. identify various types of building and common building material.
2. mention uses of buildings.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
The students can state uses of common building materials.
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of:
1. Building plans, cement, sand, gravel.
2. Documentary on various types of building, charts and posters etc.
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
LESSON 1 - INTRODUCTION
Building is a structure with walls and a roof, such as a house, factory, school, church or mosque, shop, etc.
Common building materials are cement, sand, gravel, metal, plastic, wood, glass, leaves, ceramics, grass, etc.
Based on the assignment given in lesson, ask the pupils to state the uses common building materials. Write all responses on the board.
USES OF COMMON BUILDING MATERIALS
1. Cement
2. Sand
3. Gravel
4. Metal
5. Plastic
6. Wood
7. Glass
8. Leaves
9. Ceramics
10. Grass, etc.
LESSON 2 REVISION OF TYPES AND USES OF COMMON BUILDING MATERIALS
LESSON 3 - WEEKLY ASSESSMENT (TEST)
ASSIGNMENT
1. Define technical drawing.
2. State 5 drawing instruments and materials.
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the students some questions; then, the teacher -
2. explains types of building.
Student’s Activities - Identify various types of building.
3. lists building materials and their uses.
Student’s Activities - Identify various types of common building materials and their uses.
4. Summarizes the lesson on the board.
Student’s Activities - Copy as the teacher writes.
CONCLUSION
To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
LESSON EVALUATION
Ask students to:
1. list types of building.
2. list five common types of building materials.
NEXT LESSON

CONTENT OF THE LESSON
LESSON 1 - INTRODUCTION
Shelter is one of the basic needs of life. A shelter is a basic architectural structure or building that provides protection from the local environment. Having a place of shelter, of safety and of retreat, i.e. a home, is commonly considered a fundamental human needs.
Sometimes, it is called house or home.
MEANING OF BUILDING
Building is a structure with walls and a roof, such as a house, factory, school, church or mosque, shop, etc.
TYPES OF BUILDINGS
1. Residential buildings - Bungalow, duplex, detached and semi detached, hut, high rise, sky scrapers, etc.
2. Educational or Institutional Building - Primary, Secondary, Polytechnic, College of Education and University Buildings.
3. Assembly Buildings - Hall, Cinema, Church or Mosque, etc.
4. Factory and Industrial Buildings
5. Worship Center - Church, Mosque or Shrine.
6. Business Building - Bank, Insurance, Filling Station, Market, Shopping Mall, etc.
7. Hospital Building
ASSIGNMENT
Find out common building materials.
LESSON 2 - COMMON BUILDING MATERIALS
1. Cement
2. Sand
3. Gravel
4. Metal
5. Plastic
6. Wood
7. Glass
8. Leaves
9. Ceramics
10. Grass, etc.
ASSIGNMENT
Find out the uses of common building materials.
PRESENTATION

1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the students some questions; then, the teacher -
2. explains types of building.

3. Summarizes the lesson on the board.
Student’s Activities - Copy as the teacher writes.
CONCLUSION
To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.

2. list five common types of building materials.

LESSON 1 - INTRODUCTION
Board practice can be defined as the best practice of using drawing board for technical drawing with appropriate technical drawing instruments and materials.
BASIC BOARD PRACTICE
Activity 4 - Positioning and drawing the title block.

1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the students some questions; then, the teacher -
